body:
We often link fear with complete darkness; the absence of light stirs our imagination and the unknown grips our minds, which is why darkness is a staple in nearly every horror film out there.

However, director Rahul Sadasivan defies this norm with a fresh perspective.

While there are night scenes, much of the film is bathed in bright light, whether from the sun streaming in or the stylish artificial lighting used indoors and to my surprise, this choice didn't hinder the horror at all; instead, the ambiance and atmosphere were spot-on, perfectly aligning with the film's overall tonality and vibe.

I feel a significant portion of the credit goes to the exceptional sound design by Jayadevan Chakkadath, which is among the best I've encountered in recent times. The attention to detail, its richness, and overall fidelity are simply remarkable.

If only the story and performances, especially from our protagonist, Pranav, had been more convincing, I would have been more inclined to provide a higher rating for this.

It's not another "Brahmayugam" but still impressive in its own right!

Dies Irae isn't a masterpiece that'll haunt your dreams, but it's a good, glossy diversion for fans of atmospheric Malayalam fare. It simmers without boiling over-much like a first kiss that hints at passion yet holds back. Worth a watch for the performances and sound alone, but don't expect to lose sleep.

Its a cinematic masterpiece that redefines the horror genre, standing as a stunning display of technical and narrative brilliance.

The film's major plus points are its extraordinary cinematography and phenomenal sound engineering, which work in chilling concert to build a pervasive atmosphere of terror; the experience is genuinely horrible purely through these visual and sound technics, without a single ghost appearance, making the technical execution a triumph. Of course a very good movie direction.

This is all built upon a fantastic screenplay that is intelligent and brilliantly paced, supporting a cast where all the performances are good and impressive, with Pranav's performance being particularly classic and stylish.

As a whole, it is a fantastic horror movie that strongly suggests a thrilling continuation, hopefully leading into a brilliant 2nd part.

It's a properly hyped new age cinema and I will call it as - Not that usual psychological horror. A perfectly well written Plot, Finest work done by the Director and Tremendous performances given by the leading characters. A must watch for Horror + Mystery Lovers!

The first half of the movie was quite brilliant. It contained some new age jump scares that will chill your bones. Cinematography was excellent to feel the atmosphere around the horror build ups. The terrace scene was extremely graphic and out of the box for sure. BGM also supported this entire cinema to build it's ominous atmosphere. But in the 2nd Half, this movie suddenly switched into Investigation + Drama kind of genre. The Horror elements were suddenly got down in the later half. But the ultimate revelation was too intense and graphic as well. The way this movie ended was also spine chilling, although it's depend on audience whether they gonna like it (to research their theories) or Not.

The things to improve for this movie was- It left us with some unanswered questions or we can call it as 'Loopholes' in the plot. Some questions are still in the mind of the audiences for that they have to wait for it's 2nd part, which is not in the plan of Writer-Director. So that's it.

Overall, an Excellent movie in recent times especially in the Horror+ Mystery genre. One Lip Lock scene and certain graphical violence scenes also present in it. So better to avoid with Family and Child audiences! From my side, It will be 7 Out of 10 Stars for it..

The movie was good. The cinematography and background music was also good. It is a good thing that malayalam industry is diversifying it's genres.

But the ending was not good. The last ghost scene was unnecessary. If it has ended before, it could have made a good franchise. The film though having some good horror elements, heavily depend on jump scares.

But overall not bad to kill time.
